facts.title: Chopped Greek Salad
ingredients: 10 ounces chopped romaine lettuce* (about 2 medium or 3 small heads, chopped)
1 medium cucumber (about 8 ounces), seeded and chopped
½ medium red onion, chopped (about 1 cup)
½ cup pitted and halved Kalamata olives
6 ounces feta cheese, sliced into ¼” cubes (about 1 ¼ cups)
2 medium cloves garlic, pressed or minced
½ teaspoon salt, more to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Pinch of red pepper flakes, for heat (optional)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
